SOL preserves the distinction between real drumbeats, echoes, and imagined sounds.
SOL keeps the trapped-prey image and smooths the word order.

SOL keeps the question and removes redundant timing language.
SOL keeps the sudden realization and approaching tremors in natural English.

“On every side” keeps the encircling image.

“Unseen” is an awkward calque; SOL keeps the three emotions sweeping through the hall.

SOL preserves the Emperor looking down with age-worn features in natural English.
SOL keeps their attempt to drown out fear with furious shouts.

SOL keeps the point of view and the pair’s mutual gaze.

SOL keeps the answer-and-key image and her lack of joy.

SOL preserves the angled ends and connecting flash without the cumbersome clause.

SOL keeps the tender voice and action in a natural construction.
